workflow.input_bound_policy: Official DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 tokenizer.json: BPE with ByteLevel pretokenizer and empty normalizer. Content token count bounded by UTF-8 bytes. Official encoding README uses short role/BOS/assistant/thinking markers for the two-message, text-only system/user requests; runner reserves 128+32/message. No tools, images or response JSON schema. Official max position embeddings=1048576; local conservative window=48000. Actual provider usage is retained and checked by Runtime. References: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731/tree/main and encoding/README.md.

baseline.policy: fixed English query; no LLM; top 20 sources; top 10 fragments, max 3 per source
